text_block_list.name: Voice on Screen
text_block_list.text: "—Next, we would be honored to hear a few words from Lady Fine."

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: ...Your Highness?

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness.
A word, please.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yes, allow me to report.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I have a report. I, Fine Motion,
as promised beforehand—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...I shall return home in one year.
Prior to that, I must attend to several matters—"
Ever since the new year began, Fine Motion has been quite busy.

I was told there was a national council meeting today as well,
so I was waiting for it to finish, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Sorry, Trainer!
Kept you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The people over there are mostly so easygoing~.
I ended up getting caught up chatting with them about all sorts of things.
choice_data_list: Well then, let's head to training.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, can we wait until after a short break?
I want to wet my whistle.
The way she used to be, she would have wanted to run as soon as possible... but lately, she seems somewhat reluctant.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
...Would you mind going after Her Highness?

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: No one has the right to intrude upon His Highness's heart. And yet, if it is you—perhaps you would be permitted to ask.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Nothin's changed since back then, huh.
Not your runnin'... and not that stubborn streak of yours, either.

When I went after Fine Motion,
she was talking with Air Shakur.
Not wanting to interrupt, I thought about turning back, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just do what you always do.
Throwing a tantrum like a damn brat.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"‘I want to run more’—
That's all it really took, wasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't think that at all.
I've been allowed to run more than enough already."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What's the deal? You're usually much better
at lying than that, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Shakur, surely you understand?
What matters to me above all else...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I truly, genuinely want to fulfill my duty,
and that it isn't something noble or beautiful
like 'self-sacrifice.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "...Trust Her Royal Highness to have the leisure of mind for philosophizing."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And now you've tried to settle it all in your head, only to fail miserably. You haven't come to terms with anything, have you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
At the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, you finally realized it.
The true thrill of racing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And you must've felt it, too.
—To hell with any "mission," I just want to keep running here forever... that kind of feeling.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Shakur, please stop?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
However, that instinct is something you want to suppress with reason, even by force.
That's why you don't want to run.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Can't focus, no extra gear.
...And here I know you can run way better than this!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you tell your Trainer?
I bet you haven't said a damn thing to 'em.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
From the day she asked me for a mock race,
her mind's been totally locked in.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Maybe... that really is true.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I haven't been...
properly relying on that person.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: In that case—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But you know, Shakur.
I can't lean on you... any more than this.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer is already carrying
so much on their shoulders for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to lean on your resolve any more than I already have.
Besides...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I must hold it back all on my own.
...For the sake of what lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch... Stubborn as hell!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Shakur, wait...!
Thank you for worrying about me!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Everything I do is for myself.
I'm not like you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What if... what if you
defy the data, will something change—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...That's all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't really understand data.
But I don't think you and I are all that different."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because I've known it ever since we first met.
Someday, without fail, this person will need me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —That's why I felt I had to be by their side.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...!
You're so damn arrogant...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, seems like it.
I'm arrogant and incredibly stubborn, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Then, hypothetically speaking...
If I asked you to... would you keep running?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What if I told you I needed that?
Would you become my god?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...!
...Forget it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I am sorry, Shakur.
I am in love with destiny.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...I must—learn to love it.

Right now, she wants to stand on her own feet.
But if she ever needs this hand—
that will be the time to fulfill our very first vow.
